Readable at 40px on navy #0b1730 under 61% black cooldown. No text, numbers, border, tile, frame, watermark or scenery.

revision_subjects.lunge: ONE long straight silver rapier with a crimson inset, gripped by a small gold gauntlet, thrusting FORWARD horizontally to the RIGHT. revision_subjects.dread: ONE large DARK PLUM musical eighth NOTE (recognizable single note head and stem), edged warm gold, with one broad shivering sound wave in muted coral. Ominous minor-key fear motif. Main note is dark, clearly visible gold edge. No lute, no instrument, no weapon, no face.
revision_subjects.solo: ONE simple ivory human figure standing upright under a narrow golden SPOTLIGHT cone from above, with ONE rising curved golden musical note to the side and small coral cloth accent. revision_subjects.guardstone: ONE floating thick rough grey STONE monolith with carved abstract gold angular rune, in front of and shielding ONE SMALL simple ally figure below right. revision_subjects.note: exactly ONE musical eighth-note symbol, with a round solid golden note head and sharp straight stem ending in one small flag. It shoots diagonally like a dart, a tapered coral-red luminous speed tail behind it. Palette warm gold, ivory highlights, coral red accents. NO INSTRUMENTS: no lute, no harp, no wood instrument, no strings, no weapon, no face, no letters.

revision_constraints: Atlas is STYLE ONLY. Do not copy its motifs. Limit to bold simple readable masses. Keep all effects compact around the subject. Transparent, ONE icon.
